title: Extension of a quasi-coherent open section from an ideal power
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf represented by ideal-sheaf data [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $U$ an open with $V(I)=X\setminus U$. For every section $s\in E(U)$, there exist $n\geq0$ and $\alpha:I^n\to E$ such that for every open $W\subseteq U$ and $a\in I^n(W)$, $\alpha_W(a)=a\,s|_W$, using the canonical inclusion $I^n\to\mathcal O_X$ and ideal-sheaf-data powers (the zeroth power is the unit ideal) [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk].

source.place: Tag 01YB (coherent-lemma-homs-over-open), structure-module case and internal-Hom/tensor-Hom paragraphs before the kernel argument.

proof.text: Extend the finite-type image of the section map O_U to E|U to a finite-type quasi-coherent submodule G of E. On the Noetherian scheme this submodule is coherent.

The quasi-coherent annihilators of I-powers form an increasing chain in G. By ACC they stabilize at T=G_r. Artin-Rees yields c with I^(r+c)G intersect T=0. The submodule G prime=I^(r+c)G has zero annihilator for every I-power and agrees with G on U.

Apply the sections comparison to G prime. Its annihilator quotients equal G prime, so colimit evaluation gives a representative I^n to G prime of the section. Compose with the inclusion into E. On U each power is O_U; O-linear maps from O_U are multiplication by their value at 1. Naturality gives the equality on every W contained in U. The affine power formula identifies recursive powers with ideal-data powers, including zero.

theorem quasicoherent_open_section_ideal_extension
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens)
    (hI : (I.support : Set X) = (U : Set X)ᶜ) (s : E.val.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (α : (I ^ n).toModules ⟶ E),
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U) (a : (I ^ n).toModules.val.obj (op W)),
        α.val.app (op W) a =
          (I ^ n).toModulesι.val.app (op W) a • E.val.map (homOfLE h).op s
